verdict.rationale: Undermind produces AI-generated insights inside the product: written syntheses, a brainstorming AI expert that has read the literature, and custom tables. It also answers questions across the user's workspace papers and uploaded PDFs, and offers suggestions through follow-up questions and role-aware alerts. Community users corroborate useful ranked, annotated results. Missing for 10: insights over user data beyond literature and uploaded papers, and independent hands-on corroboration of workspace-based analysis and suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
